cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you join my request to keep the pottery room open late? It looks like a personal favour with one name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Your name would show it's bigger than the evening class.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The morning class wants weekend access.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add that. Could you bring two of them? We'd be several classes asking for better access.

mechanism: A corrects a narrow class request into a properly representative access proposal, recruiting B and another class to make A position broader.
confusable: D52 seeks a visible endorsement; D55 changes who joins the coalition and can broaden terms to recruit them.
comparison: Shed alternative recruits new plot holders through shared keys; pottery alternative trades weekend access for cross-class participation.
seedUse: Pottery hours, five oclock departure and morning-class weekends derive from D55-b; S03 adds constituency and drafting corrections.
